jmt.common.exception.SolverException

Packages that use SolverException
Package
Description
analytical
Analytical JMVA model layer: constants, parameters and the model data structure of the alphanumeric MVA solver, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
jaba.link
Link component of the JABA graphical interface.
jmt.commandline
Command line interface of the JMT suite.
jmva.link
Link between the JMVA GUI and the model data structures of the JSIM graph editor.
solvers.dispatchers
Solver dispatchers of JMVA, which select and drive the appropriate exact or approximate solution algorithm for the model under study.
solvers.dispatchers.wrappers
Wrapper solvers used by the JMVA dispatchers.
solvers.priority
Priority support of the JMVA solvers: Priority MVA (P-MVA) and Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators for models with priority classes.
